**Route.** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` is a published skill, and the 「governed 面统一定义」 line names `skills/**` in full ⇒ `domain:skills` by the 域车道 table's 「governed 面全量」 row. `priority:*` and `type` ⛔ withheld per 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」.

## ⚠️ One reading handed to the grading lane, because the charter names this exact case

北极星「优先级」4, last sentence: 「**写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷**」. This is that sentence's literal subject — a **published skill**, the artefact an AI author reads before writing a page — and the defect is not a stale mention:

> Names share one flat, instance-global space with the URL, so a bare `user_guide` would **collide across packages and fail at install** (ADR-0048).

⭐ **It cites ADR-0048 as its authority for a claim ADR-0048 retired.** §3.4, verbatim: 「The cross-package **throw is retired**; two distinct packages coexist on the same bare name by construction.」 ⇒ a reader who checks the citation finds the opposite of what the text says, and a reader who does not check writes their pages around a failure mode that does not exist.

⇒ when the skills lane grades it, that clause is the one to grade against. ⛔ This is a reading, ⛔ not a grade.

## ⚠️ Three separable errors — ⛔ do not close on one

The card measures **three**, and they are not one sentence with one fix: (1) 「one flat, instance-global space」 is replaced by §3.1/§3.3 routing on the package id with packaged items under a composite key; (2) 「collide across packages」; (3) 「fail at install」. A repair that softens the sentence without answering all three leaves the skill teaching some of it. Whoever takes it records a disposition per error.

⭐ This is the second instance of the SAME retired ADR-0048 claim found this round — objectstack-ai/objectstack#19359 carries it in `collect-docs.ts`'s module header, where the same file already retracts it 900 lines down. ⇒ these two are the same correction reaching different copies, and whoever fixes either should sweep for a third rather than assume two is the count.

⚠️ From a read-only prose sweep commissioned **after the docs-drift check disclaimed coverage** ⇒ ⛔ no gate is watching this surface; that gap is its own question.
